title: dB span and knee (implementation-defined)
why: The spec maps volume onto 3-12% but never states the dB span, nor what the baseline is anchored to. This implementation anchors 0 dB to the speaker's own normal level and compresses +/-6 dB around it, so ordinary prosody (which swings ~15 dB from stress alone) does not consume the range reserved for shouting and whispering.
